question: Which decorator marks a TypeScript class as an Angular component?
discussion: Selected Answer: A @Component declares a class as a component and links it to a template and styles.
Selected Answer: A @Directive is for directives, @Injectable for services, @NgModule for modules.

question: Which decorator (or signal function) passes data from a parent component into a child component?
discussion: Selected Answer: B @Input (or the input() function) lets a parent bind a value into the child.
Selected Answer: B @Output is the opposite direction: child → parent.

question: Which function creates a writable signal in modern Angular?
discussion: Selected Answer: A signal(initialValue) creates a writable signal whose value can be read and updated.
Selected Answer: A computed() derives a value from other signals.

question: Choose two valid Angular component lifecycle hooks.
discussion: Selected Answer: AC ngOnInit runs once after inputs are set; ngOnDestroy runs before the component is destroyed.
Selected Answer: AC There is no ngOnRender or ngOnCreate hook in Angular.

question: What is the primary role of Dependency Injection (DI) in Angular?

options.A: To provide dependencies to components and services without manually instantiating them

discussion: Selected Answer: A The injector creates and shares service instances and passes them where requested.
Selected Answer: A DI improves testability and decouples code.

question: Which decorator marks a class as an injectable service and registers it at the root level?
discussion: Selected Answer: A @Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' }) makes the service a singleton available app-wide.
Selected Answer: A This is the tree-shakable way to register a service.

question: Which syntax enables two-way data binding on a form control?
discussion: Selected Answer: C [(ngModel)] is the banana-in-a-box syntax combining property and event binding.
Selected Answer: C Two-way binding requires FormsModule for ngModel.

question: What is the purpose of an Angular pipe?

options.A: To transform data for display in a template

discussion: Selected Answer: A Pipes such as date, currency, and uppercase transform values in templates.
Selected Answer: A Custom pipes implement the PipeTransform interface.

question: Which element is the placeholder where routed components are rendered?
discussion: Selected Answer: C <router-outlet> marks where the Router displays the active component.
Selected Answer: C <ng-content> is for content projection, not routing.

question: Which Angular CLI command creates a new workspace and application?
discussion: Selected Answer: A ng new <name> scaffolds a new Angular workspace.
Selected Answer: A ng generate (ng g) is used to add files within an existing workspace.

question: In Angular's new built-in control flow, which block renders a list of items?
discussion: Selected Answer: B @for (item of items; track item.id) iterates over a collection.
Selected Answer: B @defer defers loading, @if and @switch are conditional.

question: Which decorator lets a directive/component listen to events on its host element?
discussion: Selected Answer: A @HostListener('click', ['$event']) listens to host DOM events.
Selected Answer: A @HostBinding binds a host property to a class field.

question: Which change detection strategy only re-checks a component when its inputs change?
discussion: Selected Answer: B ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush skips checks unless a reference input changes or a signal is read in the template.
Selected Answer: B OnPush improves performance for pure/presentational components.

question: How does a child component send data back to its parent?
discussion: Selected Answer: A An @Output emitter (or output()) raises events that the parent listens to.
Selected Answer: A The parent subscribes with (eventName)="handler()" syntax.

question: What is a standalone component in Angular?

options.A: A component that must be declared in an NgModule
options.B: A component that is self-contained and does not require an NgModule
options.C: A component that only works offline
options.D: A component rendered on the server only

discussion: Selected Answer: B Standalone components (standalone: true) declare their own imports and can be used without NgModules.
Selected Answer: B They are the default and recommended style in current Angular versions.
